newsitem.title: USA: IRIDIUM to launch its first 3 satellites.
newsitem.headline: IRIDIUM to launch its first 3 satellites.

text.p: IRIDIUM LLC on Monday said it planned to launch its first three satellites on January 8.
Motorola Inc has a 25 percent stake in IRIDIUM, a consortium that is working to provide a global telecommunications network using 66 low-orbit satellites.

IRIDIUM said the satellites will be carried into orbit on a Delta II rocket, manufactured by McDonnell Douglas Corp. The launch will take place at Vandenberg Air Force Base in Lompoc, California, the consortium said.
Commercial service is planned for late 1998, when the network is scheduled to become operational.
The first three satellites will be used to test satellite command and control capabilities, as well as the basic hardware and software of the network.
